text:
mira_cs: quick heads-up — LumenPay (acct lp_9842) is going into EU alpha next week and asked for a temporary surge window + IP allowlist. They expect a few big bursts during checkout flows. Can we support a short exempt window?

jonah_ops: what's the exact ask? rps or token limits? duration?

mira_cs: they want 4x the current rate limit on /v1/generate for 2 weeks starting 2026-04-09 UTC, and an allowlist for their peak egress IP blocks so retried requests don't drop under burst throttle. They supplied two CIDRs to start (they may add more): 10.1.2.0/24, 35.202.64.0/18

samir_eng: we can do an account-scoped rate multiplier + IP allowlist. need account id (lp_9842 — thanks) and exact start/end ISO times. I'll create a canary in eu-west-1 first. Config snippet I'll apply: 
```json
{
  "account_id": "lp_9842",
  "policy": {
    "rate_multiplier": 4,
    "routes": ["/v1/generate"],
    "allowlist": ["10.1.2.0/24", "35.202.64.0/18"],
    "start": "2026-04-09T00:00:00Z",
    "end": "2026-04-23T00:00:00Z",
    "notes": "alpha launch surge window"
  }
}
```

kevin_am: I'll flag billing so we can track any overage or convert to a temporary commit. Also note: successful launch reduces renewal risk — capture this in CRM.

samir_eng: created infra ticket INF-5487 to add the allowlist + rate policy, will scope canary rollout then global. Pushing change id chg-2921. ETA to finish changes and PR: ~24h.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: chg-2921 -> eu-west-1 canary at 2026-04-09T02:00:00Z.

jonah_ops: I'll add an alert: account_lp_9842_rate_throttle_pct > 0.5% -> paging. Also monitoring token burn and autoscale headroom for the dedicated pool.

mira_cs: customer also wants per-route latency dashboard and token-level cost breakdown. Can product/console team expose a quick view? We'll capture as feedback for Redwood Optimize.

samir_eng: tagging product backlog is fine — I'll add a short doc on the route-level metrics needed. For now we can wire a temporary dashboard in Grafana using per-route traces.

kevin_am: scheduling enablement call with LumenPay on Thu 4/7 10:00am UTC to walk through retry guidance and best practices. Mira, can you collect their peak windows and any other IPs they will send?

mira_cs: yep — asked Alex to send full peak IP list by EOD tomorrow. I'll also gather their top 10 prompt templates for quality monitoring and share feedback items to product.

samir_eng: ack. I'll post PR and include rollout playbook (rollback steps, fallback to smaller model variant if we hit memory pressure).

jonah_ops: thumbs up — I'll be on-call during the first 48h of the window.

kevin_am: tagging this as low->medium renewal risk improvement if launch goes well. Will follow up in CRM after enablement. :thumbsup:

mira_cs: thanks team. summary: INF-5487 + chg-2921 created, allowlist + 4x rate multiplier scheduled, canary rollout in eu-west-1 on 2026-04-09. action items: samir -> complete PR (24h), jonah -> alerts & monitor, kevin -> billing/CRM, mira -> collect IP list + enablement prep.

samir_eng: posting PR link in thread when ready.
